column1: # Explicit financial labels. These select digit reading, never bank validation.
# A customer value of disabled suppresses the same system cue.
# Identifier labels beyond the finance set. Without a row the digits are read as
# a quantity, so 우편번호 06236 became 육천이백삼십육 and lost its leading zero.
# Passwords and PINs are read digit by digit: 비밀번호 451233 -> 사오일이삼삼.
# A counted number after the label (비밀번호 4자리) keeps its counter reading.
# A letter+digit code next to Korean text (speech output) outranks the generic
# alphanumeric term over the same extent: K37PA1798 reads 케이 삼칠 피에이 일칠구팔.
# Vehicle plate syllables (25후 5748 -> 이십오후 오칠사팔). 호 (rooms) and 동 (buildings)
# Clothing sizes 44..99 before this word read digit by digit (55사이즈 -> 오오사이즈).
# Apparel sizes in a Korean sentence (AI Hub 159 size references): 2XL~6XL read
# the English multiplier and the size word (투 엑스라지, 177 refs); bare XL is
# 엑스라지 (41:2), XS 엑스스몰 (8:5). Bra sizes: band value and cup letters.
# A secret or ticket code after these words is read digit by digit even when it
# is short and carries 번 (비밀번호 7537번 칠오삼칠번). Other labels keep a short
# queue number as a count (예약번호 89번 팔십구 번). AI Hub 159 references, 2026-10-01:
# 비밀번호 201 digits / 0 count, 예매번호 13 / 0, 예약번호 83 / 78 (kept as a count).
# 아이디 sun38: lowercase letters with digits after this label are a code
# (references spell 538 of 554 lowercase identifiers; 2026-10-06). ID is not a
# label: it also starts English text (ID 0-123-45678-9).
# Service numbers read digit by digit when a call cue is near (119에 신고,
# 114에 전화해서, 전화번호가 112와 113); without one they stay values (114명,
# Hotlines read digit by digit with a call cue (1391 아동학대, 1399 불량식품, 1339,
# Rates read 할, 푼, 리 (타율 0.212 이할 일푼 이리; 2026-10-07).
# Words that make a doubled number a clothing size (펄블랙 66을; 2026-10-07).
